items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: You ever see Lewis when he plays, he uses a towel over his horn all the time?

ctx.x: What about those blues? Did the clarinet players specialize in blues much?

Oh yeah. That's what made it so great. The clarinet and trombone players, the way they would harmonize and make high notes and come down and low register and play. And finally the trumpet player you would take a solo and they would make stop time, what we would call after beats. And he would put mutes, his doily on his trumpet. And he would get a lot out of it without using the vowels on the trumpet. Real great. You couldn't imagine, I mean the difference, and today and at that time. Without using the vowels you…
Who did Chris usually have on the trombone?
